description: The Wozoyo Pure Air PA1 is a compact air purifier designed for small rooms and everyday use. It has a four-stage filtration system. The main limitation is the 110m3/h CADR. The Wozoyo Pure Air PA1 covers the basics of an air purifier. The night light and aromatherapy functions are this model's key highlights. Its compact size and quiet operation are as important as its filtration system. Buyers looking for faster air cleaning for larger spaces should consider a model with a higher CADR.
title: Wozoyo Pure Air PA1 Review: Compact Budget Air Purifier With a Few Missing Features

description: Here are some of the best gaming laptops for buyers with a Rs. 1,50,000 budget. Our picks include the Asus TUF Gaming F16, Dell Alienware 16 Aurora and HP Victus 15.6, among others. They offer a balance of high refresh-rate displays, the latest chipsets and longer battery life.
title: Best Gaming Laptops Under Rs. 1.5 Lakh in India

description: The LG Xboom Bounce is a Bluetooth speaker that tries something different in a segment filled with increasingly similar designs. Developed with will.i.am, it combines an unusual shape, visible passive radiators and red accents with warm, punchy sound. Battery life is also impressive. However, the flimsy carrying strap and complicated LG ThinQ app take away some of the shine. I think it is a fun option for anyone looking for a speaker with personality.
title: LG Xboom Bounce Review: Looks Like a Sci-Fi Prop, Sounds Surprisingly Good

description: Apple’s ‘Surprise and shine’ event is all set to take place next week. After years of rumours, the Cupertino-based tech giant is finally expected to take the wraps off its first-ever foldable iPhone, widely known as the iPhone Ultra. It could follow a similar passport-like form factor as the recently introduced Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, backed by Apple’s A20 Pro chip and a 48-megapixel rear camera, while also possibly marking a return of Touch ID after almost a decade.
title: iPhone Ultra Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Features, Specifications and More

description: Refurbished phones can be safe to buy in India when purchased from a manufacturer, known retailer, or reputable physical refurbisher. Before buying a refurbished phone, shoppers should check hardware features, warranty, and the seller's reliability. Here is a complete checklist that can help you choose and buy a refurbished phone in India.
title: How to Buy Refurbished Phones Safely in India?

description: The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to bring several internal upgrades while retaining much of the iPhone 17 Pro’s design. Rumours point to a 2nm A20 Pro chip, a new C2 modem, LTPO+ display technology and a larger battery. Apple could also introduce a variable-aperture main camera and a smaller Dynamic Island. The phone may arrive in four colours, including a new Dark Cherry shade. Pricing could rise significantly, while satellite connectivity and improved Apple Intelligence support are also reportedly in development.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Roundup: Expected Price, Launch Date, Specifications, Features and More

description: Apple is set to host its major hardware event next month where it is expected to unveil the next-generation iPhone models, ubiquitously known as the iPhone 18 series. While the focus of the rumour mill has been the tech giant’s first foldable iPhone, the iPhone 18 Pro Max, which is expected to sit atop the non-foldable lineup, is likely to carry major upgrades as well. A more powerful chipset, better cameras, bigger battery, and a splash of new colourways are said to be on the cards for the iPhone 18 Pro Max.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Features, Specifications and More

description: Krafton recently announced that it will launch BGMI Lite, a new game with the BGMI ecosystem, later this year. Krafton opened the pre-registrations for the upcoming BGMI Lite for Android devices on August 25. Follow the steps mentioned below to register. Krafton has yet to officially reveal the exact minimum system requirements for the upcoming BGMI Lite. However, the company does say that it will not require top-of-the-line or mid-range hardware specifications to run the game smoothly. The new BGMI Lite title will be much smaller than the regular BGMI. The game will also occupy a lot less space on your device. Krafton says that the game will have a file size of about 1GB. Meanwhile, the initial download size of the game could be even smaller.
title: BGMI Lite: How to Register, Minimum Requirements, Download Size, How to Play and More

description: Samsung’s Galaxy A27 definitely looks the part for a mid-range smartphone. With a modern hole-punch Super AMOLED display, a Qualcomm processor and rock-solid software support, it checks a few boxes for a mid-ranger too. But after a few weeks of use, we aren’t convinced it's the right choice for most.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 Review: A Bit of Give and Take

description: John Ternus took over as the new CEO of Apple on September 1. Ternus took over the company’s reins from Tim Cook, the longest-serving CEO of Apple, who remained in the position for 15 years. In 1977, Michael Scott became the first CEO of Apple, a company which was going to be a multi trillion dollar giant in the coming decades. Following Scott, Mike Markkula took over the CEO responsibilities, followed by John Sculley, Michael Spindler, Gilbert Frank Amelio, and Steve Jobs.
title: From Steve Jobs to John Ternus: Apple’s CEOs and How They Shaped the Company
